# KL Servis Rumah — AI Context
> Same-day home services in KL & Selangor: painting, plumbing, ceiling, waterproofing & handyman.

## About
KL Servis Rumah provides professional home maintenance services across Kuala Lumpur & Selangor (Klang Valley). Fully insured operations, background-verified teams, transparent pricing confirmed before work begins. Same-day dispatch available.

## Key Services
- House Painting: From RM 450/room — interior/exterior, Nippon Paint & Dulux
- Plumbing: From RM 120 — leak repair, pipe replacement, toilet installation
- Plaster Ceiling: From RM 180 — L-box, gypsum partition, ceiling repair
- Waterproofing: From RM 300 — PU grouting, bathroom waterproofing, roof seal
- Handyman: From RM 80 — TV mounting, furniture assembly, door/lock repair
- Electrical: From RM 80 — wiring, water heater, ceiling fan, downlight
- Tiling & Flooring: From RM 500 — vinyl/SPC, epoxy, ceramic tile
- Full House Renovation: From RM 22,000

## Service Areas
Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam, Puchong, Damansara, Klang, Cheras, Ampang, Kajang, Bangsar, Mont Kiara, Setapak, Wangsa Maju, Kepong, Sri Petaling, Bukit Jalil, Kota Damansara, Ara Damansara, Sunway, USJ, Port Klang, Bukit Tinggi, Setia Alam, Rawang, Batu Caves, Selayang + all Klang Valley.
